title: Natural section reconstruction counit on affine perfect complexes
statement: For a scheme W and affine open U, terminal sections followed by the actual affinePerfectSheafification [lem-pc-affine-perfect-module-model], termwise on complexes, admits a natural transformation to the identity. Its component is an isomorphism on every IsStrictlyPerfect complex [def-pc-perfect-complex].

source.document: Stacks Project; Mathlib and the existing Lean library

proof.text: Construct the canonical spectrum-chart equivalence and transport the tilde/sections adjunction to the localized site. Its right adjoint is terminal evaluation by the chart-sections comparison from lem-sc-affine-free-terminal-sections-reconstruction. This defines the natural reconstruction counit.

The affine perfect module model places every term in the essential image of the fully faithful sheafification functor. The adjunction counit is invertible on this image. Map the natural counit to complexes and use termwise invertibility to prove each strictly perfect component invertible.

lean.statement: theorem affine_perfect_sections_counit (W : Scheme.{v}) (U : W.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) : let F : SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U) ⥤ ModuleCat.{v} Γ(W, U) := SheafOfModules.evaluation _ (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) letI : F.Additive := inferInstanceAs ((SheafOfModules.forget _ ⋙ PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ _).Additive) ∃ ε : F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ (affinePerfectSheafification W U hU).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⟶ 𝟭 (CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ), ∀ K, IsStrictlyPerfect W U K → IsIso (ε.app K)
